headline: Azerbaijan Oil and Petroleum Exports to Italy Rise 9.3% in Ten Months
summary: The value of oil and petroleum product exports from Azerbaijan to Italy rose by 9.3% to $6.8 billion from January through October 2026.
why: Bilateral energy trade volumes drive foreign exchange earnings and trade balance figures for oil-exporting nations.

impacts.name: Azerbaijan
impacts.why: Higher export revenues contribute positively to the national trade balance and energy sector earnings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
